questions.prompt: An isosceles triangle's base angles each measure (4x - 2)°, and its vertex angle measures (2x + 14)°. Find x and the angle measures.
questions.prompt_markup:
An isosceles triangle's base angles each measure (4x - 2)°, and its vertex angle measures (2x + 14)°.
Find x and the angle measures.
questions.correct_answer: x = 17; the base angles are 66° and the vertex angle is 48°.
questions.grading_note: Form required: x and the angles. The base angles are equal, so 2(4x - 2) + 2x + 14 = 180, giving 10x = 170.

questions.prompt: An exterior angle of a triangle measures 5x°. The two remote interior angles measure (2x + 6)° and (x + 30)°. What is x?
questions.prompt_markup:
An exterior angle of a triangle measures 5x°. The two remote interior angles measure (2x + 6)° and (x + 30)°.
What is x?
questions.grading_note: An exterior angle equals the sum of the remote interior angles: 5x = 3x + 36, so x = 18.
